text:
[Council File 26-1072]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Been Held]
HOUSING COMMITTEE REPORT relative to Measure United to House Los Angeles (ULA) property transfer tax exemptions for non-profit entities created specifically for property acquisitions.
Recommendation(s) for Council action, as initiated by Motion (McOsker – Yaroslavsky):
1. INSTRUCT the Los Angeles Housing Department, with the assistance of the Chief Legislative Analyst (CLA), Office of Finance, and City Attorney, to present the proposal to the ULA Citizen Oversight Committee (COC) pursuant to Los Angeles Administrative Code 22.618.S(b) for review so that the ULA COC may express an opinion on whether the exemption proposal, and its potential retroactive application, furthers the purposes of Measure ULA and is consistent with the expenditure categories of Measure ULA.
2. INSTRUCT the Office of Finance:
a. To report within 90 days to identify non-profit organizations that would have fallen under this amendment.
b. In consultation with the City Attorney, to provide the feasibility of retroactively extending the exemptions and refunding those collections to the appropriate non-profit entity.
Fiscal Impact Statement:
Neither the City Administrative Officer nor the CLA has completed a financial analysis of this report.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
summary: The city would provide property transfer tax breaks to non-profit organizations that acquire housing for low-income residents.
